A row of four houses with a low stone wall in the foreground. Ornamental carvings on the house fronts indicate that the owners have given feasts of merit.
A group of people around a flat trough into which rice is being poured. One man is holding a hoe-like implement. In the foreground is a deep trough made from a log.

Portrait of five men standing in front of a house. One is wearing an apron decorated with cowrie shells in two blocks, three stripes and a zigzag line and ear ornaments with long strings. He is holding a spear with a goat-hair tuft and a dao. He and the other men are wearing neck ornaments of two pairs of boars' tusks with shell plates and cornelian beads, and necklaces of long tubular shells. On their wrists are cylindrical ornaments of cane covered with cowrie shells and with a bristly edge of short goat hair, and on their arms thick ivory armlets indicating high status. Two men are smoking brass pipes. Three of them wear fringed body cloths. In the background stands a tall bamboo pole with a tuft of leaves tied to it.

Portrait of a European man and a Naga man standing in a village clearing. The European man is wearing a shirt, jacket, kilt, boots, gaiters and a hat. He is holding a shotgun and smoking a pipe. The Naga man is wearing a white cloth round his waist, a dark body cloth, thick ivory armlets, bead necklaces and earrings with small wool balls. He is holding a walking stick and a leather and canvas bag.
A group of men pounding rice in flat troughs with hoe-like implements. Behind them is a stacked pile of wood.

Two men standing in front of a house. Both are carrying baskets with straps round their foreheads and holding spears. The older man is wearing a fringed body cloth, cane armlets covered in cowrie shells and a neck ornament of boars' tusks. He is smoking a pipe. The younger man is wearing and apron, and a dog is sitting in his basket. Another dog is standing next to the men. The house is constructed out of bamboo with a palm leaf roof.
Photograph of a print depicting British officers and Naga people.
A woman and three children sitting in a village clearing. Behind the woman is a low shelter with an open front, and to the right long plant bundles (? crop) are laid onto a raised wooden platform.
A pig and two chickens inside a wooden enclosure. On the left a cloth is stretched out between two sticks.

A large group sitting on and around a viewing platform, an almost vertical wooden structure set onto a stone platform. In the foreground are two bamboo poles with mithan heads. One man is holding a bamboo drinking vessel.

Group of a woman and four children. The woman is wearing a necklace of tubular shells and an arm ornament with fluted ends. Some of the children have bead necklaces. The children have their heads shaved, except one which has a tuft of hair at the back of the head. In the background are a larger group of people and a house.
Two women and a man working in a rice field. A mountain in the background.
View of a village on a hill with a road running past it. Trees are on both sides of the road and in the foreground. Mountains in the background.
A man with cupping horns on his back crouching in front of a house. There are several cloths on the roof and a bamboo vessel next to the man.

A woman and four children sitting in front of a house. One of the children is grooming the woman's hair. Spread in front of the house are baskets and a flat trough containing something white (cotton wool?) and dried plants. Hung on the house front are bundles of dried chillies and a basket, and large baskets containing plant material hang from the roof. An ornament is carved into the house front.

Two women weaving on a backstrap tension loom. One end of the fabric is fastened out of shot and the other end is tied with a backstrap to one of the women who keeps it taut by sitting with straightened legs. The fabric passes over a wood and bamboo support with the highest point in front of the other woman, who is sitting with her back to the camera. Both women have a spindle of thread beside them. A basket is lying next to one woman and a winnowing shovel next to the other. On the right are a mat with a pile of dried chillies and a basket. Two children are standing to one side.

A village street with houses. A group of people is sitting in front of one house holding bamboo and gourd vessels. Behind them is a stack of chopped wood. Lying in the street are a mat, an oval woven tray and a rake, and there is a low enclosure made of wooden planks. A man is standing in the street, carrying wood in a basket on his back and holding a spear. Chicken are in the background.
View of a village with thatched houses, forest behind it and mountains rising in the background.
A rocky uneven road with trees on both sides. Two men are sitting on the roadside.
A man crouching with cupping horns on his back. Another man is sitting in front of him. Both are in front of a house with a cloth and a bamboo pole lying on the roof.
View of a river or a lake, with a village at the foot of a hill on the far side. A group of people is standing on the shore.
View of a lake and wooded grounds, fenced off on the right.

A group of people crossing a river on flat canoes, some of them loaded with baskets. On the shore are people with horses. The shore is overgrown with high vegetation and a forest in the background. Most of the people are wearing white turbans, perhaps as part of a uniform.

A group of people travelling. Some are marching in single file, including two bearers carrying large baskets on their backs piled high with parcels and bundles. A group is standing to the right, including two European women in long skirts, jackets and hats, two men carrying guns, a bearer who has put his load down and a dog. Most of the men are wearing white turbans, and some appear to wear a uniform. The three bearers are wearing small loincloths. High vegetation grows in the background.

A group of men wading through a stream in single file, carrying large baskets. Some are also carrying umbrellas. On the shore is a small group of men with a horse. Most are only wearing loincloths, but some wear jackets and cloths around their waists and legs. High vegetation grows on the shore.
